Summary: Greatness in God's kingdom is measured by service, a pattern set by Jesus who came not to be served but to serve and give His life as a ransom. Isaiah's Suffering Servant, the foot-washing in John 13, and Paul's teaching all call believers to humble, joyful service. The Servant King shows us that stooping to serve is the way up in His kingdom.
KeyPassages: Isaiah 42:1; Isaiah 53:11; Mark 10:43-45; John 13:14-15; Philippians 2:5-8; 1 Peter 4:10
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea; The Last Supper; The Crucifixion
